text: DarGlobal page: THE ALBERT HALL MANSION - Albert Hall Mansions History. Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

text: DarGlobal page: pagani - Frequently Asked Questions - Da Vinci by Pagani. Da Vinci Tower is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Pagani Automobili and is the world's first Pagani-branded residential development. Da Vinci Tower is located in Downtown Dubai, directly on the Dubai Canal, with views of the Burj Khalifa and moments from Marasi Business Bay. The tower offers 2, 3 and 4-bedroom residences ranging from 77 to 398 sq m, each with private outdoor areas and panoramic views of the canal and Downtown Dubai. Yes. Da Vinci Tower is the world's first residential development with interiors by Pagani, applying the brand's design philosophy to luxury living. Interiors crafted by Pagani feature premium leather, Italian marble, kinetic chandeliers, carbon fibre accents and lush wood panelling. Amenities include a rooftop pool overlooking Downtown Dubai, a state-of-the-art gym, sauna and steam rooms, 24/7 concierge, and private access to the residences through discreet elevators. The tower rises 19 floors above the Dubai Canal, with three basement levels and a grand ground floor. The Dubai Mall and Fountains are about 9 minutes away, and Dubai Marina is around 20 minutes away. Buyers investing AED 2 million or more qualify for the UAE 10-year Golden Visa, and Dubai applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax.

text: DarGlobal page: Fendi Casa - Frequently Asked Questions - Fendi Casa. Azure Oceanfront Villas is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Fendi Casa, part of the AIDA master development in Oman. The villas sit within AIDA, DarGlobal's hilltop master development on the coast near Muscat, Oman. Fendi Casa is the home and interiors division of the Italian luxury house FENDI, founded in Rome in 1925. FENDI brings a century of Italian craftsmanship and design innovation to residential interiors for the first time through this collaboration. Creative direction has passed through the Fendi family, Karl Lagerfeld from 1965 to 2019, Silvia Venturini Fendi, Kim Jones from 2020 to 2024, and Delfina Delettrez Fendi on jewellery since 2020. AIDA is one of Oman's largest premium mixed-use developments, spanning 3.5 million square metres on a hilltop over 100 metres above sea level. Specific unit details and pricing have not yet been published; contact DarGlobal directly for the latest release information. AIDA's first phase is expected to complete in 2027. AIDA also includes Trump International Hotel, Trump Golf Villas, Trump Cliff Villas and Marriott Residences. It marks Fendi Casa's entry into branded residential real estate, bringing FENDI's century of Italian luxury heritage to an oceanfront setting within AIDA.

title: How to buy property in Spain: Complete guide for foreigners 2025 – steps, costs, and legal process?

text: DarGlobal blog: How to buy property in Spain: Complete guide for foreigners 2025 – steps, costs, and legal process? - During the Sale Process. Upon deciding to purchase a Spanish property, extensive preparations are necessary both financially and legally. Draft a budget, secure funds and open a euro-denominated account to handle transactions. Obtain an official identification number (NIE) for foreign residents for completing ownership documentation. Select a property and examine it thoroughly. Hire legal counsel to navigate contracts, translations, and due diligence. Sign preliminary and final sale agreements in the presence of a notary.

text: DarGlobal blog: How to buy property in Spain: Complete guide for foreigners 2025 – steps, costs, and legal process? - Properties Under Construction: The Purchase Agreement. When buying an under-construction building, the sales contract outlines the developer's obligation to complete and deliver the property, and the obligation of the buyer to purchase on completion. The contract has to include detailed technical reports that define the property. Developers take on the risk of commercialisation and construction, and purchasers are expected to make payment terms. Altering any contract should be done through agreement. This setup enables investors to purchase properties in the early stages, usually at favorable prices.
